definitions.gloss: safety management; safety oversight; safety administration
definitions.explanation: The systematic effort by an organization to identify hazards, prevent accidents, and protect workers, users, and the public. In Japan, {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり} is a legally required activity in construction, manufacturing, transportation, schools, and many other fields, typically coordinated by a designated safety manager.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧。
⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: At construction sites, safety management is most important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧。
examples.english: The company is responsible for the health and safety management of its employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To prevent accidents, we conduct safety management training on a regular basis.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ (safety) + ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management, administration). A standard term in workplace safety, disaster prevention, and regulatory compliance.

USAGE:
- In workplaces with 50 or more employees in certain industries, Japanese law requires the appointment of an {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}{者|しゃ} (safety manager).
- Used in formal and professional contexts — training materials, company policies, government documents. Rare in everyday conversation.
- Can take ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to manage safety).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}{者|しゃ}: safety manager
- {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: safety management system
- {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧: safety management regulations
- {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: to enforce strict safety management
- {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: responsibility for safety management

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{危機|きき}{管理|かんり}→危機管理：25685_kikikanri⟧: crisis management — focuses on responding to emergencies
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}→健康管理：21662_kenkoukanri⟧: health management — focuses on employee health
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり}→品質管理：21220_hinshitsukanri⟧: quality management — focuses on product/service quality
- ⟦{労務|ろうむ}→労務：19480_roumu⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: labor management — broader administrative oversight of workers
